"""Evolvable cache replacement policy starting from LRU baseline."""

from collections import OrderedDict


class EvolvedCache:
    """Byte-based cache with evolvable replacement policy."""
    
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
    def __init__(self, capacity_bytes):
        self.capacity = capacity_bytes
        self.current_size = 0
        self.hits = 0
        self.misses = 0
        # Segmented LRU with ghost entries for better admission
        # Protected (hot) ~80%, probationary (new/cold) ~20%
        self.protected = OrderedDict()   # obj_id -> obj_size (hot items)
        self.probationary = OrderedDict()  # obj_id -> obj_size (new/cold items)
        self.protected_size = 0
        self.probationary_size = 0
        self.protected_cap = int(capacity_bytes * 0.8)
        self.freq = {}  # obj_id -> access count
        # Ghost cache: recently evicted items (no size cost)
        self.ghost = OrderedDict()  # obj_id -> True, max 1000 entries
        self.ghost_max = 1000

    def _evict_to_fit(self, obj_size):
        """Evict items until obj_size bytes are free."""
        while self.current_size + obj_size > self.capacity:
            if self.probationary:
                eid, esz = self.probationary.popitem(last=False)
                self.probationary_size -= esz
                self.current_size -= esz
                # Add to ghost set
                self.ghost[eid] = True
                if len(self.ghost) > self.ghost_max:
                    self.ghost.popitem(last=False)
            elif self.protected:
                eid, esz = self.protected.popitem(last=False)
                self.protected_size -= esz
                self.current_size -= esz
                # Demoted items go to ghost too
                self.ghost[eid] = True
                if len(self.ghost) > self.ghost_max:
                    self.ghost.popitem(last=False)
            else:
                break

    def access(self, obj_id, obj_size):
        """Process an access request. Returns True for hit, False for miss."""
        self.freq[obj_id] = self.freq.get(obj_id, 0) + 1

        if obj_id in self.protected:
            self.protected.move_to_end(obj_id)
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        if obj_id in self.probationary:
            # Promote to protected segment
            sz = self.probationary.pop(obj_id)
            self.probationary_size -= sz
            self.current_size -= sz
            # Make room in protected if needed
            while self.protected_size + sz > self.protected_cap and self.protected:
                did, dsz = self.protected.popitem(last=False)
                self.protected_size -= dsz
                # Demote to probationary
                self.probationary[did] = dsz
                self.probationary.move_to_end(did, last=True)
                self.probationary_size += dsz
                self.current_size += dsz
            self.protected[obj_id] = sz
            self.protected_size += sz
            self.current_size += sz
            self.hits += 1
            return True

        # Miss
        self.misses += 1
        if obj_size > self.capacity:
            return False

        self._evict_to_fit(obj_size)

        # Ghost hit: item was recently evicted but accessed again -> admit to protected
        if obj_id in self.ghost:
            self.ghost.pop(obj_id)
            # Try to admit directly to protected
            if self.protected_size + obj_size <= self.protected_cap:
                self.protected[obj_id] = obj_size
                self.protected_size += obj_size
                self.current_size += obj_size
            else:
                # Not enough room in protected, put in probationary
                self.probationary[obj_id] = obj_size
                self.probationary_size += obj_size
                self.current_size += obj_size
        else:
            # Insert into probationary segment
            self.probationary[obj_id] = obj_size
            self.probationary_size += obj_size
            self.current_size += obj_size
        return False
    # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
    
    def hit_rate(self):
        """Return the hit rate as a fraction."""
        total = self.hits + self.misses
        return self.hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0
